ato.name: Avatar Texture Optimizer
error.abort: ATO: build aborted due to a configuration error.
error.abort:description: See the Unity Console for details. Fix the configuration and rebuild.
error.componentNotOnDescriptor: ATO: the component on '{0}' is not on the same GameObject as the VRCAvatarDescriptor on avatar '{1}'.
error.componentNotOnDescriptor:descripti: Move the Avatar Texture Optimizer component to the same GameObject that has the VRCAvatarDescriptor, or remove it.
error.evacuationFailed: ATO: evacuation of '{0}' UV{1} to UV{2} failed: {3}; build aborted.
error.evacuationFailed:description: Choose a free UV channel that AAO does not use, then rebuild.
error.multipleComponents: ATO: found {0} Avatar Texture Optimizer components on avatar '{1}'; only one is allowed.
error.multipleComponents:description: Remove the extra Avatar Texture Optimizer components. Only one instance may exist on an avatar and its children.
error.noFreeUvChannel: ATO: renderer '{0}' UV{1} is used by AAO and no free channel is available for backup; build aborted.
error.noFreeUvChannel:description: Free a UV channel on the mesh, or remove the AAO components that depend on this channel (e.g. Remove Mesh By Mask).

setting.generateAtlas.tip: When off: no atlases, no unused-UV trimming, no UV re-layout; whole textures are scaled instead.
setting.metrics.tip: Only used when quality preset is Custom.
setting.minDensity.tip: Minimum texel density relative to real model size; prevents waste.
setting.mipmaps.tip: Bound toggle: VRChat requires MipStreaming when mipmaps are on.
setting.platformOverride.tip: When enabled, overrides all optimization parameters for this platform. Disabled platforms use the common settings.
setting.qualityPreset.tip: Target quality preset. Custom preset defaults to near-lossless (all thresholds = 1).
